lines.2: Konoe suddenly stayed home from school that day.
lines.3: The delinquents from that incident were absent too.
lines.5: On the way home from cram school that evening... Konoe was at her usual spot.
lines.8: Konoe answered with her usual attitude.
lines.9: But her body was not the same as usual.
lines.10: Painful-looking bandages were wrapped around her.
lines.11: There was even a faint trace of blood seeping through.
lines.12: One finger was in a splint.
lines.15: 「Mm? I fell down. That's why I missed school.」
lines.19: That made it even more suspicious.
lines.23: A lie. The timing was far too convenient.
lines.24: Both sides had missed school, and she had these injuries.
lines.25: Konoe had not simply stayed home. She had been unable to come.
lines.26: They had probably lain in wait for her.
lines.27: They couldn't let it go after what I did, so they went after Konoe...!
lines.28: 「It was already becoming an issue at school. Your name came up when the teachers were discussing it. That confirms it.」
lines.29: 「What? Seriously? They already know that much?」
lines.32: 「...Wow. I got tricked by you, Tsushima. That's depressing.」
lines.33: Konoe's tone really had not changed at all.
lines.35: 「Hm? I yelled, so people came running. Those idiots got caught and suspended immediately.」
lines.36: So they really had been suspended.
lines.37: 「People came running, but... look at those injuries.」
lines.38: 「There was no way I was going to let people like that bully me. Of course I fought back hard.」
lines.39: 「These are honorable wounds from that. I'm more annoyed the treatment made me miss school.」
lines.40: Konoe kept smiling exactly as she always did.
lines.41: That only made the bandages look more painful.
lines.45: 「It feels like me beating them down just put you in even more danger...」
lines.46: 「I never thought they'd go that far.」
lines.47: 「That isn't your fault, Tsushima. What are you talking about?」
lines.48: 「I'm grateful you helped me back then.」
lines.50: But there was no way she had not been afraid.
lines.53: The girl I thought I had protected had been hurt.
lines.55: If I was not there, I could not protect anyone.
lines.56: It had been arrogant to imagine myself as some television hero.
lines.57: Was one human being's strength really this limited?
lines.58: ...That day when Konoe was attacked at school.
lines.59: I could not forgive the cowardice of a group trying to hurt one girl.
lines.60: So I fought, believing that anger was righteous anger.
lines.61: But once I let the emotion carry me...
lines.63: Would it have been better to stay calm, act submissive, and try to cool their anger instead?
lines.64: Would that have settled everything peacefully?
lines.65: Would Konoe have avoided getting hurt?
lines.67: ...I suddenly felt all the strength drain out of me.
